scope: Interface refinement on local main; production browser acceptance and existing core/CLI/MCP regression checks. No paid inference or wallet signing.

Mobile function picker search, empty result, Escape and restored focus/input verified.

No permanent Swap or Read/Write list pills on the imported NFT; generic full signatures and transfer overloads remain distinct.
Agent selection and current four-argument transfer schema generate correct CLI commands; copied Claude Code installer selects --agent claude-code.

Missing-provider composer, send button and suggestions are disabled; missing injected wallet is reported honestly.

Home/workspace return navigation retains the actual selected NFT contract and URL.
Isolated zero-contract registry: home says No contracts yet / Your workspace is ready; workspace offers import without stale catalog, and custom import dialog opens.
Final production browser console has zero errors.
